record.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect about Wardha Scheme of Education?
options: Education was to be free for all children between ages 7 to 14 years.
It emphasized English as the only means to impart education.
It was to be self sufficient and not to cause any financial strain on the government.
It was to centre round certain basic crafts selected with due regard to the surrounding.
record.explanation: The Wardha Scheme emphasised the mother tongue and basic craft-centred education, not English as the only medium, so that statement is the incorrect one.
